class.name: SignallingServer
class.brief_description: RID based registry of signal heads, their kinds and aspects, and of the systems that control them.
class.description: A signal head is the lights of one model instance of [E3DRenderingServer]: it is created for that instance with [method signal_head_create] and lives exactly as long as it - freeing the instance frees the signal head. Its lights are numbered from 0, as the original engine numbers the [code]Light_On00[/code]..[code]Light_On07[/code] submodels. Low level, a signal head's lights are switched one by one ([method signal_head_light_enable], [method signal_head_light_disable], [method signal_head_light_blink]). High level, a signal head has a [SignalHeadKind] - what it can show - and shows one of its aspects at a time ([method signal_head_set_aspect]). The server knows no aspect of its own: "S1" or "Sz" is the vocabulary of a kind. Signal heads and event sources are grouped into systems. A system is the same object for every signalling system; what differs is its [SignallingImplementation], which receives the system's events and decides what they mean. A signal head or a source belongs to one system at most. A signal head, a source and a system can each be named, for scripts and for the scenery's events to find them. A name registered twice goes to the newest, as the original's name tables do. [SignalHeadNode] and [SignallingSystemNode] are node proxies of a signal head and of a system.

method.name: signal_head_create
method.description: Creates a signal head of the lights of [param instance], an [E3DRenderingServer] instance, and returns it. An instance has one signal head at most. The signal head is freed together with the instance.

method.name: signal_head_free
method.description: Frees the signal head: takes it out of its system and unregisters its name ([signal signal_head_unregistered]). The signal head of a freed instance is freed on its own.

method.name: signal_head_get_aspect
method.description: Returns the aspect the signal head shows, empty when none was set since its kind.

method.name: signal_head_get_aspects
method.description: Returns the names of the aspects the signal head's kind can show, in their declared order; empty without a kind.

method.name: signal_head_get_instance
method.description: Returns the model instance (E3DRenderingServer) whose lights the signal head is.

method.name: signal_head_get_kind
method.description: Returns the signal head's kind, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: signal_head_get_light_count
method.description: Returns the number of lights of the signal head's model - the highest numbered [code]light_onNN[/code]/[code]light_offNN[/code] pair plus one. It is 0 until the model is loaded; [signal signal_head_config_changed] tells when it is known.

method.name: signal_head_get_light_state
method.description: Returns what the [param light] was last set to.

method.name: signal_head_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the signal head is registered under, empty when it has none.

method.name: signal_head_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the signal head registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: signal_head_get_rids
method.description: Returns every signal head.

method.name: signal_head_get_system
method.description: Returns the system the signal head belongs to, or an empty RID.

method.name: signal_head_light_blink
method.description: Blinks the [param light]: on for [param on_time] seconds, off for [param off_time], the cycle shifted by [param phase] seconds. Every blinking light runs on one clock, so lights with the same times blink together.

method.name: signal_head_light_disable
method.description: Puts the [param light] out.

method.name: signal_head_light_enable
method.description: Lights the [param light], from 0 to [constant MAX_LIGHTS] - 1. A light past the model's own may be set too, as the original allows; it shows once the model has it.

method.name: signal_head_set_aspect
method.description: Shows the [param aspect] of the signal head's kind: sets each light the way the aspect describes it, then emits [signal signal_head_aspect_changed] and tells the implementation of the signal head's system ([method SignallingImplementation._signal_head_aspect_changed]). An aspect the kind does not have is refused.

method.name: signal_head_set_kind
method.description: Sets what the signal head can show. The lights are left as they are, and no aspect is shown until [method signal_head_set_aspect]. Emits [signal signal_head_config_changed].

method.name: signal_head_set_name
method.description: Registers the signal head under [param name] ([signal signal_head_registered]), unregistering its previous name. An empty name only unregisters it.

method.name: source_create
method.description: Creates an event source: a system element that is not a signal head, such as a track circuit or a dispatcher's button. It is only a handle - the element's own state stays with its owner.

method.name: source_free
method.description: Frees the source, taking it out of its system.

method.name: source_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the source is registered under.

method.name: source_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the source registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: source_get_system
method.description: Returns the system the source belongs to, or an empty RID.

method.name: source_send_event
method.description: A report of the source, handed to the implementation of the system it belongs to ([method SignallingImplementation._handle_source_event]). The sender knows only its own source; which system and implementation receive it is the server's business. A source that belongs to no system refuses it.

method.name: source_set_name
method.description: Registers the source under [param name]; an empty name only unregisters it.

method.name: system_add_signal_head
method.description: Adds the signal head to the system and tells the system's implementation. A signal head that already belongs to a system is refused.

method.name: system_add_source
method.description: Adds the event source to the system and tells the system's implementation. A source that already belongs to a system is refused.

method.name: system_attach_implementation
method.description: Gives the system its behaviour. The previous implementation is told it is detached; the new one is told it is attached and then about every signal head and source the system already has, so the order the system is set up in does not matter. [code]null[/code] only detaches.

method.name: system_create
method.description: Creates an empty system: no implementation, no signal heads, no sources.

method.name: system_free
method.description: Frees the system, detaching its implementation. Its signal heads and sources are not freed; they belong to no system afterwards.

method.name: system_get_implementation
method.description: Returns the system's implementation, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: system_get_name
method.description: Returns the name the system is registered under.

method.name: system_get_rid_by_name
method.description: Returns the system registered under [param name], or an empty RID.

method.name: system_get_signal_heads
method.description: Returns the system's signal heads, in the order they were added.

method.name: system_get_sources
method.description: Returns the system's sources, in the order they were added.

method.name: system_remove_signal_head
method.description: Takes the signal head out of the system and tells the system's implementation.

method.name: system_remove_source
method.description: Takes the source out of the system and tells the system's implementation.

method.name: system_send_event
method.description: A command to the system as a whole - from a script, a dispatcher or a scenery event - handed to its implementation ([method SignallingImplementation._handle_event]). [param arguments] carry whatever the event needs. A system without an implementation refuses it.

method.name: system_set_name
method.description: Registers the system under [param name]; an empty name only unregisters it.

signal.name: signal_head_aspect_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head shows the [param aspect].

signal.name: signal_head_config_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head's configuration changes: its kind is set, or its model is loaded and its light count is known.

signal.name: signal_head_light_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the [param light] is set to a different [enum LightState].

signal.name: signal_head_registered
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head is registered under [param name].

signal.name: signal_head_unregistered
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head's [param name] is unregistered - on a rename, or when the signal head is freed.

signal.name: system_signal_head_added
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head is added to the system.

signal.name: system_signal_head_removed
signal.description: Emitted when the signal head is taken out of the system, also when it is freed.

signal.name: system_source_added
signal.description: Emitted when the source is added to the system.

signal.name: system_source_removed
signal.description: Emitted when the source is taken out of the system, also when it is freed.

constants.constant: Lights a signal head can have, as a model of the original engine can ([code]iMaxNumLights[/code]).
